refreshNotes:
MY2025 X5 carries forward the post-LCI (Lifecycle Impulse) MY2024 refresh. PHEV trim is xDrive50e, with 25.7 kWh usable / 29.5 kWh gross battery, 483 hp combined, ~38 mi EPA electric range. MSRP $73,800 + $1,175 destination. Includes wireless charging, heated front seats, BMW Curved Display, iDrive 8.5.

Sources:
- https://www.kbb.com/bmw/x5/2025/xdrive50e/
- https://www.edmunds.com/bmw/x5/2025/plug-in-hybrid/
